nonclaims: These observations do not contain individual sampling locations, raw laboratory result rows, time-series pressure, demand, flow, pipe topology, pipe condition, or sewer levels.
They do not calibrate EPANET or SWMM and do not prove local network hydraulic behaviour.
Reported aggregate values have not been independently reproduced from raw samples.
Water quality summaries and hydraulic service reliability are different evidence domains.
Published planned replacement kilometres are targets, not actual completed works.
No claim is made that the observations are a complete or current picture of Johannesburg's water system.
Some FY2023/24 Business Plan tables have regional values that do not reconcile to printed totals; those regional values are intentionally not ingested as trusted observations.

comparisons.interpretation: Nominal arithmetic only: the Business Plan estimate converts to 14,355.757 ML/year and the programme page says approximately 8,100 ML/year. Definitions, periods, scope and saving calculation methods are not established as equivalent; the difference is not an audited performance gap.
resolution_requirements: Obtain the calculation methodology and reference period for each published estimate.
Define what constitutes saved water and whether values are potential, estimated, or measured after repair.
Establish the covered geographic/network scope and any overlap between programme activity and reported savings.
notes: The right-hand value is explicitly approximate; the derived difference should not be interpreted at false precision.
Retain both original source records and observation IDs; do not choose a winning value or combine them as one time series.
